"""Source-bound limits and opt-in preflight; no external Provider calls."""

import asyncio
import copy
import hashlib
import json

import pytest
from test_router_intelligence_phase2 import ScriptedMock, decision, router, wire_graph

from forge_core.capacity_preflight import (
    discover_input_inventory, node_review_envelope, residual_budget_snapshot,
    verified_input_inventory, verify_input_inventory,
)
from forge_core.constraints import extract_execution_constraints
from forge_core.domain import ConversationMessage, DomainError, ModelProfile, ProtocolSupport, Quest
from forge_core.graph_domain import GraphProposal, graph_contract_dump
from forge_core.model_call_budget import ModelCallBudgetLedger
from forge_core.provider_pool import ProviderPool
from forge_core.quest_graph import QuestGraphService
from forge_core.runtime import ModelCallContext
from forge_core.store import Store
from forge_core.team_composition import CompositionLimits, RoleSpec, TeamCompositionService


def prepared(tmp_path, *, content=None):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "capacity.sqlite3")
    root = store.workspace.root
    (root / "inputs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (root / "inputs" / "unicode.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"line": '中文 "quoted" \\ source\n' * 6}, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    content = content or (
        "Inspect inputs/unicode.json. Task execution limits: "
        '{"max_concurrency":1,"max_total_tokens":180000,"max_nodes":2,"max_members":2}'
    )
    user = ConversationMessage(role="user", content=content)
    store.add_message(user)
    quest = Quest(title="Verified source", goal="Inspect the complete Unicode source", metadata={
        "original_request_message_id": user.id,
        "original_request_sha256": hashlib.sha256(content.encode()).hexdigest(),
    })
    store.save_quest(quest)
    store.save_model(ModelProfile(id="big", provider="p", model_id="big", display_name="Big",
        context_window=65536, max_output_tokens=4096,
        tool_calling_support=ProtocolSupport(supported=True, source="user_override")))
    return store, quest


def capacity_graph():
    data = wire_graph()
    data.update(max_total_tokens=180000, coordination_reserve_tokens=18000)
    node = data["nodes"][0]
    node.update(budget_tokens=150000, required_capabilities=[], required_input_paths=["inputs/unicode.json"],
        capacity_bounds={"max_source_receipt_bytes": 2048, "max_artifact_bytes": 3072, "max_delivery_bytes": 1536})
    return data


def generate(store, quest, provider, **kwargs):
    service = QuestGraphService(store, **kwargs)
    return asyncio.run(service.generate(quest.id, expected_version=0, provider=provider, model_id="big",
        provider_id="p", capabilities={"json_schema": True}, capability_sources={"json_schema": "mock"},
        context_limit=65536, require_capacity_contract=True))


def test_literal_structured_limits_bind_unicode_spans_and_intersect():
    text = '前言 Task execution limits: {"max_concurrency":2,"max_total_tokens":100}。 Task execution limits: {"max_concurrency":1}'
    result = extract_execution_constraints("message-exact", text)
    assert result["limits"] == {"max_concurrency": 1, "max_total_tokens": 100}
    assert result["source_sha256"] == hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
    assert all(text[span["start"]:span["end"]] == span["text"] for span in result["source_spans"])
    assert extract_execution_constraints("m", "one researcher; Gateway concurrency 2") is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("block", [
    '{"max_concurrency":true}', '{"max_concurrency":0}', '{"max_concurrency":1.0}',
    '{"max_concurrency":1,"max_concurrency":2}', '{"some_role":"research"}', '[]', '{bad}',
])
def test_invalid_explicit_execution_block_cannot_become_a_weak_hint(block):
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        extract_execution_constraints("m", "Task execution limits: " + block)


def test_router_persists_structured_source_bound_limits(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "router.sqlite3")
    provider = ScriptedMock(decision("create_quest"))
    text = 'Inspect one file. Task execution limits: {"max_concurrency":1}'
    result = asyncio.run(router(store, provider).handle_user_message(text, request_id="cap"))
    metadata = json.loads(store.get_quest(result["quest_id"])["metadata"])
    binding = metadata["execution_constraints"]
    assert binding["limits"]["max_concurrency"] == 1
    assert binding["source_message_id"] == metadata["original_request_message_id"]
    assert binding["source_sha256"] == metadata["original_request_sha256"]


def test_inventory_uses_actual_wrapper_bytes_and_detects_tampered_manifest(tmp_path):
    store, _ = prepared(tmp_path)
    root = store.workspace.root
    actual = verified_input_inventory(store, ["inputs/unicode.json"])[0]
    manifest = [{**actual, "source_bytes": 999999, "contains_excerpts": True}]
    (root / "inputs" / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest), encoding="utf-8")
    inventory = verified_input_inventory(store, ["inputs/unicode.json", "inputs/manifest.json"])
    wrapper = next(item for item in inventory if item["path"] == "inputs/unicode.json")
    assert wrapper["bytes"] == len((root / wrapper["path"]).read_bytes()) < 999999
    manifest[0]["bytes"] += 1
    (root / "inputs" / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest), encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="actual file bytes/hash"):
        verify_input_inventory(store, inventory)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("path", ["../outside.json", "inputs/../../outside.json", ".env", "data/operator-settings.json"])
def test_inventory_obeys_existing_workspace_governance(tmp_path, path):
    store, _ = prepared(tmp_path)
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        verified_input_inventory(store, [path])


def test_output_reference_remains_unknown_until_a_producer_contract(tmp_path):
    store, _ = prepared(tmp_path)
    result = discover_input_inventory(store, "Read inputs/unicode.json; write work/future.json.")
    assert [item["path"] for item in result] == ["inputs/unicode.json"]


def test_new_planner_repairs_underfunded_node_once_with_same_cap(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(tmp_path)
    first, second = capacity_graph(), capacity_graph()
    first["nodes"][0]["budget_tokens"] = 10000
    provider = ScriptedMock(first, second)
    plan = generate(store, quest, provider)
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2
    limits = [json.loads(req.messages[1]["content"])["limits"] for req in provider.requests]
    assert limits[0]["max_total_tokens"] == limits[1]["max_total_tokens"] == 180000
    assert "No eligible model fits" in provider.requests[1].messages[-1]["content"]
    assert plan["capacity_contract"]["input_inventory"][0]["bytes"] > 100
    assert plan["capacity_contract"]["nodes"]["n0"]["review_cycle_reserve"] > 10000
    assert plan["execution_constraints"]["limits"]["max_concurrency"] == 1
    assert store.list_workers(quest.id) == []


def test_undeclared_future_input_is_not_assumed_zero(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(tmp_path)
    data = capacity_graph()
    data["nodes"][0]["required_input_paths"] = ["work/unproduced.json"]
    provider = ScriptedMock(data)
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="Invalid graph proposal"):
        generate(store, quest, provider)
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2
    assert "declared direct predecessor" in provider.requests[1].messages[-1]["content"]
    assert QuestGraphService(store).history(quest.id) == []


def test_input_change_blocks_approval_without_rewriting_plan(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(tmp_path)
    service = QuestGraphService(store)
    plan = generate(store, quest, ScriptedMock(capacity_graph()))
    before = service.get(quest.id)
    (store.workspace.root / "inputs" / "unicode.json").write_text("tampered", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="inventory changed"):
        service.approve(quest.id, plan["digest"], plan["revision"], expected_version=1, actor="local_user")
    assert service.get(quest.id) == before


def test_team_hard_task_concurrency_independent_of_operator_limit(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(tmp_path)
    graph = QuestGraphService(store)
    raw = {"nodes": [{"key": "one", "objective": "Inspect", "success_criteria": ["done"], "budget_tokens": 500}], "edges": [], "max_total_tokens": 180000}
    plan = graph.propose(quest.id, raw, expected_version=0)
    graph.approve(quest.id, plan["digest"], 1, expected_version=1, actor="local_user")
    service = TeamCompositionService(store, operator_max_concurrency=4)
    roles = [RoleSpec(id="research", task_node_key="one", input_tokens=100, output_tokens=100)]
    limits = CompositionLimits(max_members=2, max_depth=1, max_concurrency=2, max_total_tokens=200)
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="max_concurrency exceeds source-bound"):
        service.propose(quest.id, roles, limits, strategy="greedy", expected_version=2)
    assert store.get_quest(quest.id)["version"] == 2
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM team_proposals").fetchone()[0] == 0


def test_composer_actual_selected_model_context_recheck(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(tmp_path)
    plan = generate(store, quest, ScriptedMock(capacity_graph()))
    graph = QuestGraphService(store)
    graph.approve(quest.id, plan["digest"], 1, expected_version=1, actor="local_user")
    store.save_model(store.list_models()[0].model_copy(update={"context_window": 4096}))
    service = TeamCompositionService(store, capacity_providers=ProviderPool({"p": ScriptedMock({})}))
    roles = [RoleSpec(id="research", task_node_key="n0", tools=["directory_list", "file_read"], input_tokens=147952, output_tokens=2048)]
    limits = CompositionLimits(max_members=1, max_depth=1, max_concurrency=1, max_total_tokens=150000, allowed_tools=["directory_list", "file_read"])
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="selected model context"):
        service.propose(quest.id, roles, limits, strategy="greedy", expected_version=2)


def test_unknown_model_profile_cannot_pass_capacity_by_omission(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(tmp_path)
    model = store.list_models()[0].model_copy(update={"context_window": None})
    store.save_model(model)
    provider = ScriptedMock(capacity_graph())
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="Invalid graph proposal"):
        generate(store, quest, provider)
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2


def test_scope_residual_includes_opening_and_unresolved_reservations(tmp_path):
    store, quest = prepared(tmp_path)
    ledger = ModelCallBudgetLedger(store.path, token_limit=200000, concurrency_limit=4,
        scope_limits={("workspace", store.workspace.id): (190000, 4)})
    ledger.admit(ModelCallContext(call_id="unresolved", purpose="planner", workspace_id=store.workspace.id, quest_id=quest.id), "p", "big", input_tokens=2000, output_tokens=1000, remote_timeout=1)
    with store.connection() as connection:
        result = residual_budget_snapshot(connection, store, quest.id, 180000, ledger)
    assert result["remaining"] == 177000
    assert len(result["scopes"]) == 4
    provider = ScriptedMock(capacity_graph())
    data = capacity_graph()
    data["nodes"][0]["budget_tokens"] = 161000
    provider = ScriptedMock(data)
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="Invalid graph proposal"):
        generate(store, quest, provider, budget_ledger=ledger)
    assert "residual" in provider.requests[1].messages[-1]["content"]


def test_legacy_manual_canonical_shape_omits_all_new_contract_fields():
    raw = {"nodes": [{"key": "a", "objective": "Legacy", "success_criteria": ["done"], "budget_tokens": 10}], "edges": []}
    result = graph_contract_dump(GraphProposal.model_validate(raw))
    assert "capacity_contract" not in result and "execution_constraints" not in result
    assert "coordination_reserve_tokens" not in result
    assert "required_input_paths" not in result["nodes"][0]
    assert result["nodes"][0]["expected_artifact"] is None

"""Quest ambiguity depends on bounded identity recall, separate from source facts."""

import asyncio

import pytest
from test_router_intelligence_phase2 import ScriptedMock, decision

from forge_core.context_service import ContextService
from forge_core.domain import ConversationMessage, Quest
from forge_core.registry import ModelRegistry, TeamComposer
from forge_core.router import RouterService
from forge_core.store import Store


def service(store, quest):
    return RouterService(
        store,
        TeamComposer(ModelRegistry(store)),
        provider=ScriptedMock(decision("continue_quest", quest_id=quest.id, candidates=[quest.id])),
        model_id="explicit-mock",
        context_limit=65536,
    )


def snapshot(router, query):
    router._sync_memory()
    with router.store.connection() as connection:
        return router._snapshot(connection, query)


def test_many_constraint_sources_do_not_hide_one_matching_quest(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "constraint-hits.sqlite3")
    target = Quest(title="Nebula decoder", goal="Inspect the original code")
    store.save_quest(target)
    for index in range(60):
        store.add_message(
            ConversationMessage(
                role="user", content=f"Nebula constraint {index}: Do not delete measurements."
            )
        )
    router = service(store, target)
    observed = snapshot(router, "Continue Nebula constraints")
    assert observed["memory"]["omitted"]
    assert not observed["quest_lookup"]["omitted"]
    assert observed["quest_lookup"]["cursor"] is None
    assert observed["recalled_ids"] == [target.id]
    result = asyncio.run(
        router.handle_user_message("Continue Nebula constraints", request_id="one-identity")
    )
    assert result["intent"] == "continue_quest" and result["quest_id"] == target.id


def test_two_matching_quest_identities_still_require_clarification(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "two-identities.sqlite3")
    first = Quest(title="Nebula first", goal="Inspect decoder")
    second = Quest(title="Nebula second", goal="Inspect encoder")
    store.save_quest(first)
    store.save_quest(second)
    router = service(store, first)
    observed = snapshot(router, "Continue Nebula")
    assert set(observed["recalled_ids"]) == {first.id, second.id}
    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message("Continue Nebula", request_id="two-identities"))
    assert result["intent"] == "ambiguous" and result["quest_id"] is None


def test_bounded_quest_results_preserve_omission_and_ambiguity(tmp_path):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "many-identities.sqlite3")
    targets = [
        Quest(title=f"Nebula candidate {index}", goal="Inspect decoder") for index in range(101)
    ]
    for quest in targets:
        store.save_quest(quest)
    router = service(store, targets[0])
    observed = snapshot(router, "Continue Nebula")
    assert len(observed["quest_lookup"]["items"]) == 100
    assert observed["quest_lookup"]["omitted"] and observed["quest_lookup"]["cursor"]
    result = asyncio.run(
        router.handle_user_message("Continue Nebula", request_id="bounded-identities")
    )
    assert result["intent"] == "ambiguous"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit", [False, True])
def test_prefilter_candidate_cap_stays_unresolved_unless_user_names_exact_id(tmp_path, explicit):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "hidden-identity.sqlite3")
    target = Quest(title="Nebula target", goal="Inspect decoder")
    store.save_quest(target)
    for index in range(520):
        store.add_message(ConversationMessage(role="user", content=f"Nebula memo {index}"))
    router = service(store, target)
    query = f"Continue Nebula {target.id}" if explicit else "Continue Nebula"

    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message(query, request_id="hidden-identity"))
    assert result["intent"] == ("continue_quest" if explicit else "ambiguous")

"""Router consumes actual bounded semantic selections; lexical retrieval remains."""

import asyncio
import json

from test_router_intelligence_phase2 import ScriptedMock, decision

from forge_core.domain import Quest
from forge_core.registry import ModelRegistry, TeamComposer
from forge_core.router import RouterService
from forge_core.runtime import ModelResponse
from forge_core.settings import Workspace
from forge_core.store import Store


class RouterSelector:
    execution_mode = "mock"

    def __init__(self, selected, final=None):
        self.selected, self.final = selected, final or decision()
        self.requests = []

    async def generate(self, request):
        self.requests.append(request)
        if request.budget_context.purpose == "memory_semantic_retrieval":
            candidates = json.loads(request.messages[1]["content"])["candidates"]
            result = {"candidate_ids": [self.selected] if self.selected in candidates else []}
        else:
            result = self.final
        return ModelResponse(text=json.dumps(result), tool_calls=[], usage={}, finish_reason="mock")


def prepared(tmp_path, provider):
    store = Store(tmp_path / "router.sqlite3", workspace=Workspace.from_path(tmp_path))
    router = RouterService(store, TeamComposer(ModelRegistry(store)), provider=provider,
        model_id="explicit-mock", context_limit=65536, semantic_recall=True)
    return store, router


def test_router_includes_zero_overlap_semantic_memory_with_original_trust(tmp_path):
    provider = RouterSelector("placeholder")
    _, router = prepared(tmp_path, provider)
    identity = router.memory_service.remember("Never disclose passwords or credentials in logs.",
        kind="decision", layer="L2", source_refs=["message:earlier"], status="hypothesis")
    provider.selected = "memory:" + identity
    query = "How should we avoid spilling confidential material?"
    assert router.memory_service.retrieve_context(query)["items"] == []
    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message(query, request_id="semantic"))
    assert result["intent"] == "chat"
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2
    actual = json.loads(provider.requests[-1].messages[1]["content"])
    assert actual["semantic_recall"]["status"] == "selected"
    item = next(item for item in actual["memory"] if item["id"] == identity)
    assert item["status"] == "hypothesis" and item["source_refs"] == ["message:earlier"]


def test_semantic_task_identity_can_reopen_an_older_quest(tmp_path):
    provider = RouterSelector("placeholder")
    store, router = prepared(tmp_path, provider)
    target = Quest(title="Nebula", goal="Construct a safe priority queue")
    store.save_quest(target)
    for index in range(22):
        store.save_quest(Quest(title=f"Recent unrelated {index}", goal="Other work"))
    router._sync_memory()
    provider.selected = "quest:" + target.id
    provider.final = decision("continue_quest", quest_id=target.id, candidates=[target.id])
    query = "Resume the starvation resistant scheduling exploration"
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert target.id not in {row["id"] for row in router._snapshot(connection, query)["quests"]}
    result = asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message(query, request_id="old-semantic"))
    assert result["intent"] == "continue_quest" and result["quest_id"] == target.id
    assert len(provider.requests) == 2


def test_legacy_router_does_not_add_semantic_provider_call(tmp_path):
    provider = ScriptedMock(decision())
    store = Store(tmp_path / "legacy.sqlite3", workspace=Workspace.from_path(tmp_path))
    router = RouterService(store, TeamComposer(ModelRegistry(store)), provider=provider, model_id="mock")
    asyncio.run(router.handle_user_message("hello", request_id="legacy"))
    assert len(provider.requests) == 1

"""Offline state mechanics for approved remaining DAGs and bounded child expansion."""

import copy
import json

import pytest
from test_team_reassignment_m5 import prepared_team

from forge_core.domain import DomainError
from forge_core.plan_lineage import validated_lineage_source
from forge_core.quest_graph import QuestGraphService
from forge_core.team_composition import CompositionLimits, RoleSpec


def prepared(tmp_path):
    store, quest, plan, roles, limits, teams, _, manager, runs = prepared_team(tmp_path)
    # This explicit Mock fixture isolates transition/counter mechanics. It is
    # never an execution-quality or live PASS acceptance claim.
    with store.unit_of_work() as work:
        for run, state in zip(runs, ("succeeded", "blocked"), strict=True):
            work.connection.execute("UPDATE worker_runs SET state=?,token_spent=7,steps=1 WHERE id=?", (state, run["id"]))
            work.connection.execute("UPDATE task_nodes SET status=? WHERE plan_id=? AND node_key=?", (state, plan["id"], run["node_key"]))
    with store.connection() as connection:
        raw = json.loads(connection.execute("SELECT graph_json FROM quest_plans WHERE id=?", (plan["id"],)).fetchone()[0])
    return store, quest, plan, raw, roles, limits, teams, manager, runs


def test_stage_then_user_approval_preserves_completed_runs_counters_and_ledger(tmp_path):
    store, quest, parent, raw, *_rest, runs = prepared(tmp_path)
    service = QuestGraphService(store)
    with store.connection() as connection:
        old_runs = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs ORDER BY id")]
        old_ledger = [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_budget_ledger ORDER BY scope,scope_id")]
    raw["nodes"][1]["objective"] = "Correct unfinished work using earlier receipts"
    before = store.get_quest(quest.id)
    staged = service.propose_remaining(quest.id, raw, expected_version=before["version"])
    assert store.get_quest(quest.id)["plan_revision"] == parent["revision"]
    assert staged["status"] == "proposed" and staged["revision"] > parent["revision"]
    with store.connection() as connection:
        assert [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs ORDER BY id")] == old_runs
    approved = service.approve(quest.id, staged["digest"], staged["revision"], expected_version=before["version"] + 1, actor="local_user")
    with store.connection() as connection:
        current = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM quest_plans WHERE id=?", (approved["id"],)).fetchone()
        inherited = validated_lineage_source(connection, store.get_quest(quest.id), current, "a")
        assert inherited["source_run"]["id"] == runs[0]["id"]
        assert dict(connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (runs[0]["id"],)).fetchone()) == next(row for row in old_runs if row["id"] == runs[0]["id"])
        cancelled = connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_runs WHERE id=?", (runs[1]["id"],)).fetchone()
        assert cancelled["state"] == "cancelled" and cancelled["token_spent"] == 7 and cancelled["steps"] == 1
        assert [dict(row) for row in connection.execute("SELECT * FROM worker_budget_ledger ORDER BY scope,scope_id")] == old_ledger


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["completed_contract", "global_budget", "unsettled_model", "unsettled_tool"])
def test_remaining_rejects_unsafe_revision_without_switching_plan(tmp_path, mutation):
    store, quest, parent, raw, *_rest, runs = prepared(tmp_path)
    if mutation == "completed_contract":
        raw["nodes"][0]["objective"] = "Changed completed obligations"
    elif mutation == "global_budget":
        raw["max_total_tokens"] += 1
    else:
        with store.unit_of_work() as work:
            if mutation == "unsettled_model":
                work.connection.execute("UPDATE worker_runs SET state='running' WHERE id=?", (runs[1]["id"],))
            else:
                work.connection.execute("INSERT INTO worker_tool_calls(run_id,call_id,model_call_id,tool_name,arguments_json,state) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,'uncertain')", (runs[1]["id"], "open", "open", "file_read", "{}"))
    before = store.get_quest(quest.id)
    with pytest.raises(DomainError):
        QuestGraphService(store).propose_remaining(quest.id, raw, expected_version=before["version"])
    assert store.get_quest(quest.id) == before
    assert len(QuestGraphService(store).history(quest.id)) == 1


def expansion(raw):
    data = copy.deepcopy(raw)
    parent = data["nodes"].pop(1)
    children = [{**copy.deepcopy(parent), "key": key, "objective": f"Child {key}: {parent['objective']}", "budget_tokens": 400} for key in ("b_design", "b_review")]
    data["nodes"].extend(children)
    data["edges"] = [{"source": "b_design", "target": "b_review", "condition": "success"}]
    return data


def test_bounded_expansion_requires_new_approval_and_role_depth_matches_real_children(tmp_path):
    store, quest, parent, raw, _, _, teams, *_ = prepared(tmp_path)
    service = QuestGraphService(store)
    before = store.get_quest(quest.id)
    staged = service.propose_remaining(quest.id, expansion(raw), expected_version=before["version"], expansion_parent="b")
    record = staged["hierarchical_expansions"][0]
    assert record["parent_node_key"] == "b" and record["depth"] == 1
    assert set(record["child_node_keys"]) == {"b_design", "b_review"}
    assert store.get_quest(quest.id)["plan_revision"] == parent["revision"]
    service.approve(quest.id, staged["digest"], staged["revision"], expected_version=before["version"] + 1, actor="local_user")
    roles = [RoleSpec(id=role, task_node_key=key, input_tokens=100, output_tokens=100, depth=0) for role, key in (("architect", "b_design"), ("reviewer", "b_review"))]
    limits = CompositionLimits(max_members=2, max_depth=1, max_concurrency=1, max_total_tokens=400)
    version = store.get_quest(quest.id)["version"]
    with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="Role depth"):
        teams.propose(quest.id, roles, limits, strategy="greedy", expected_version=version)
    for role in roles:
        role.depth = 1
    team = teams.propose(quest.id, roles, limits, strategy="greedy", expected_version=version)
    assert {member["depth"] for member in team["members"]} == {1}
    assert "a" not in {member["task_node_key"] for member in team["members"]}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["tool", "parent_budget", "delivery_criteria", "other_contract", "depth"])
def test_hierarchical_expansion_cannot_increase_authority_or_parent_budget(tmp_path, mutation):
    store, quest, _, raw, *_ = prepared(tmp_path)
    data = expansion(raw)
    if mutation == "tool":
        data["nodes"][1]["allowed_tools"] = ["file_write"]
    elif mutation == "parent_budget":
        for node in data["nodes"][1:]:
            node["budget_tokens"] = 501
        data["nodes"][0]["budget_tokens"] = 900  # cannot pay by weakening completed contract
    elif mutation == "delivery_criteria":
        for node in data["nodes"][1:]:
            node["success_criteria"] = ["weaker"]
    elif mutation == "other_contract":
        data["nodes"][0]["objective"] = "Change completed research"
    else:
        # A second real expansion would exceed this explicit source limit.
        source_limits = {"limits": {"max_depth": 0}}
        from forge_core.hierarchical_plans import expansion_contract
        original = {**raw, "execution_constraints": source_limits}
        with pytest.raises(DomainError, match="depth/node/member"):
            expansion_contract(original, data, {"id": "p", "digest": "d"}, "b", {"a"})
        return
    with pytest.raises((DomainError, ValueError)):
        QuestGraphService(store).propose_remaining(quest.id, data, expected_version=store.get_quest(quest.id)["version"], expansion_parent="b")
